name: line-oss-crm
description: Open-source LINE Official Account CRM/marketing automation

scripts.deploy:client: node scripts/render-wrangler-config.mjs --client "$CLIENT_CONFIG" --out apps/worker/wrangler.client.toml --web-env-out apps/web/.env.production.local && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --config apps/worker/wrangler.client.toml
scripts.db:migrate:client: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config apps/worker/wrangler.client.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
